posts.title: Where It Breaks
posts.instagram:
Every deal has a breaking point. Know yours before you buy.

In the BRRRR Fixer example, the refinance returns 98% of your cash ($145,150 of $148,700) and nets $312 a month. The stress test shows where it breaks: a refinance rate above 10.30%.
